name: Kagura Shouko
source:
Is a second year student. At the beginning of the story, she transfers to the school and becomes classmates with Kanon.
Personality is very sociable and becomes intimate with anyone immediately. Appearance is also very cute.
At the time of transferring, she receives treatment as an idol from her peers.
While very optimistic, she has a clumsy side. However there is a sense of mystery around her as well.
She seems to be behaving cheerful on purpose to conceal her original self.

She woke up to her ability as a holy warrior after being attacked by a demon. From there on, she starts fighting against monsters alongside Kanon.
Her class is of a magic archer. Using her bow to fire magic arrows, she covers for Kanon, who is the vanguard type.
For Kanon, she is a reliable comrade and close friend, however after being violated by a monster, her body was controlled by the darkness.
Yielding to the temptation she turned traitor to Kanon and drags her into the humiliating world of depravity.
